title: Subject-Disjoint Benchmarking of Lightweight Detectors for Visible Driver-Cue Localization
description: Reproducibility package for a subject-disjoint benchmark of lightweight object detectors for visible driver-cue localization. It includes frozen RGB and NIR protocols, media-free authored annotations and split metadata, pinned configurations and dependencies, evaluation and publication tools, sanitized predictions, metrics, and publication artifacts. Licensed DMD and Drive&Act source media and trained checkpoints are not included.
